name: Iron Wad
description: Open in the court stance with the feet paired and qi pooled so the piece sits like part of the body.

name: Clear Breech
description: Draw a clear line of sight from eye to muzzle and mark the foe along it.

name: Unsparing Pattern
description: Fire two quick shots at one foe in a matched rhythm.

name: Wrathful Pump
description: Close a wide spread into a ring that tightens upon the foes at its centre.

name: Invincible Bead
description: Parry with the barrel on the first beat and return a shot on the second.

name: Beadvortex
description: Fall back in a paired-step curve that keeps the muzzle fixed upon the foe.

name: Glint Pumpgrip
description: Run qi in two tracks through one load so a single shot pierces and breaks.

name: Eviscerating Buckshot
description: Fire in matched sweeps from left and right so a guard has no safe side.

name: Facet Blast
description: Drive the full weight of both tracks into one load that bursts armour and the body below it.

name: Radiant Choke
description: Read how a foe's movement flows like a river and name where it will pool.

name: Might Shell
description: Load pellets in a smooth stream down the barrel so none stick or double.

name: Glint Slugchamber
description: Fire a load that splits into two streams to strike two points upon one foe.

name: Torrent Sawnedge
description: Step along the bank of the foe's approach and fire from beside it.

name: Unbudging Doublebarrel
description: Stand like a stone in a river and let the foe's rush part around the barrel.

name: Pump Devastation
description: Send a current of qi through the spread so the pellets sweep sideways across the foes.

name: Granite Buckshot
description: Cross two spreads over a ford so a foe cannot step through either.

name: Vitalwad
description: Turn in a tight eddy while recharging so the muzzle is back in line at once.

name: Siltbead
description: Pour wave after wave of spreads over a front until the foes are swept from it.

name: Glintbreech
description: Join two qi streams in one load so it drives through a foe's cover as a single plug.

name: Daybreak Spreadshot
description: Carry the full qi flow into a rolling barrage that breaks every line it meets.

name: Verity Pellet
description: Hold the foes in a wide hawk's gaze and pick the one who falters.

name: Gust Pumpgrip
description: Close on the foe in a swift low step with the muzzle level as a hawk's talons.

name: Mayhem Slug
description: Fire a clawing spread at close reach so the pellets rake like talons.

name: Adamantine Shell
description: Settle on a perch of rock or wall and hold the aim steady as a watching hawk.

name: Slag Pellet
description: Drop from a height firing so the spread falls upon the foes below.

name: Breechmettle
description: Sweep the barrel out like a wing to turn aside a spear and rake the foe's arm.

name: Pumpblink
description: Leap back while firing so the shot and the retreat are one motion.

name: Ironpump
description: Narrow the fan to a hawk's strike so it pierces armour at one point.

name: Intent Sawnedge
description: Wheel about a foe in a ring of three shots that each strike from a new side.

name: Novablast
description: Flash down from a height in a blur and fire the spread as the feet land.

name: Doublebarrel Vitality
description: Dress two shooters side by side so their reaches cross without overlap.

name: Granite Slugchamber
description: Advance beside a partner in matched pace so their muzzles keep one line.

name: Vengeful Blast
description: Fire from the left of the pair at the nearest foe.

name: Glint Spreadshot
description: Answer the partner's shot from the right at the same foe.

name: Iron Breech
description: Stand shoulder to shoulder with a partner to turn aside a charge.

name: Pattern Ruin
description: Cross two spreads from either shoulder so the foes between have no gap to pass.

name: Radiant Wad
description: Hand a fresh piece to a partner while recharging the empty one.

name: Vital Choke
description: Link qi with a partner so both shots leave the barrels as one stroke.

name: Hellish Pump
description: Fall back by turns so one partner fires while the other retires.

name: Blazepellet
description: Strike with a partner from either flank so the foes are caught between two spreads.

name: Weighty Sawnedge
description: Concentrate two pieces upon one point so the foe's line is broken at once.

name: Breechscourge
description: Close both muzzles on one point in the same instant so the joined blast overwhelms a whole rank.

name: Remnant Slugchamber
description: Read a barricade's weak joints with a long calm sweep of qi.

name: Silt Buckshot
description: Approach the barricade by a line the defenders' muzzles cannot easily follow.

name: Grievous Slug
description: Fire at a joint of the barricade to loosen the rest of it.

name: Pumpgrip Hardihood
description: Walk through falling splinters with qi hardening the hide and the arm raised.

name: Might Wad
description: Recharge in the shelter of a broken post before the next blast.

name: Nova Choke
description: Send qi into a short close blast that splits a post.

name: Daybreak Breech
description: Sweep the top of a barricade with a spread to drive off the defenders.

name: Blasthavoc
description: Fire into the edge of a breach to widen it for those who follow.

name: Hour Spreadshot
description: Pin the defenders behind their line with a wave of fire while the breach opens.

name: Mayhemchoke
description: Concentrate the whole charge upon a rampart so earth and timber burst apart.

name: Doctrine Pattern
description: Fire in rising steps up a breach so each shot clears the ground for the next.

name: Slug Havoc
description: Drive qi through the foundation line so the barricade collapses upon the defenders.

name: Dazzling Hour Doublebarrel
description: Flash through a fresh breach and fire a blast inside before the defenders turn.

name: Intentbreech
description: Breathe by two tracks of the body so the qi runs to arms and legs at once.

name: Veritychoke
description: Align the two tracks upon the mark and feel them agree.

name: Meteoric Shell
description: Cross the feet along two tracks so the body moves without the muzzle moving.

name: Hoarfrost Blast
description: Fire a snap shot while both tracks carry the kick through the whole frame.

name: Slag Wad
description: Split the pellet load along two tracks so it strikes two foes in the same instant.

name: Iron Pellet
description: Fold both tracks about the piece so a blow upon it is lost in the body.

name: Shellinsight
description: Swap the qi from arm to arm as the hands recharge so the shot stays unbroken.

name: Pumpruin
description: Run both tracks into a needle of pellets that pierces a shield and a body together.

name: Granite Shell
description: Rotate qi through both tracks so the barrage continues without a pause in it.

name: Spreadshot Scourge
description: Hold both tracks at full draw then loose a single blast that fills the whole front of the muzzle.
